texts.firmware.data_file.about: %1 of the original Prince of Persia %2 (DOS): %3. You have to supply it. The package contains none of the game's data. A modified file of your own can be used instead, and the project records exactly which file it was.
texts.firmware.not_needed_with_levels: It is not needed when the project has a level set of its own.
texts.firmware.what.digisnd1_dat: the digitized sound effects for the Sound Blaster
texts.firmware.what.digisnd2_dat: the digitized cutscene and level sounds for the Sound Blaster
texts.firmware.what.digisnd3_dat: the digitized sound effects for the Sound Blaster
texts.firmware.what.guard1_dat: the colours of the palace guards
texts.firmware.what.guard2_dat: the colours of the dungeon guards
texts.firmware.what.ibm_snd1_dat: the PC speaker sounds. The game opens this file whichever sound card is chosen
texts.firmware.what.ibm_snd2_dat: the PC speaker music. The game opens this file whichever sound card is chosen
texts.firmware.what.levels_dat: the fifteen levels, with the tiles of every room, the doors and the guards
texts.firmware.what.midisnd2_dat: the AdLib music of the title and cutscenes
texts.firmware.what.prince_dat: the pictures that all levels share (the sword, the flames, the potions) and the palettes. In 1.3 and 1.4 it also holds the level colours
texts.firmware.what.prince_exe: the release's program. It is only checked and never run, because SDLPoP is the program. It is the file that tells 1.0 from 1.1 and 1.3 from 1.4, whose data files are the same
texts.firmware.what.pv_dat: the princess and Jaffar in the cutscenes
texts.firmware.what.title_dat: the title screens, the story pages and the hall of fame
texts.firmware.what.vdungeon_dat: the walls and floors of the dungeon levels
texts.firmware.what.vpalace_dat: the walls and floors of the palace levels
texts.property.collision_previous_row: Row the collision before it was checked on
texts.property.collision_row: Row the last collision was checked on
texts.property.effects_feather_fall: Ticks of feather fall left (the green potion)
texts.property.events_last: 1 when event i is the last its button triggers
texts.property.events_room_high: The door's room, high three bits
texts.property.events_room_low: The door's room, low two bits (room = Room Low + 4 x Room High)
texts.property.events_tile: The tile (0-29) of the door event i opens or closes
texts.property.events_timer: Event i's timer (a jammed button's is 0x1F)
texts.property.guard_can_see_kid: 0 cannot see him, 1 sees him, 2 sees him and nothing is in between
texts.property.guard_direction: The way he faces; None when there is no guard
texts.property.guard_dropped_out: Nonzero once he has fallen out of the room
texts.property.guard_is_noticing: Nonzero while he notices the prince
texts.property.guard_notice_timer: Ticks before he reacts to the prince
texts.property.guard_refrac: Ticks before he can strike again
texts.property.guard_shadow_initialized: Nonzero once the shadow has been set up on this level
texts.property.guard_skills_advance_probabilit: Out of 255: how likely he is to advance
texts.property.guard_skills_block_probability: Out of 255: how likely he is to block a strike
texts.property.guard_skills_extra_strength: Hit points he has beyond his level's
texts.property.guard_skills_impaired_block_pro: Out of 255: how likely he is to block while impaired
texts.property.guard_skills_refractory_timer: Ticks he waits after a strike
texts.property.guard_skills_restrike_probabili: Out of 255: how likely he is to strike again after a blocked strike
texts.property.guard_skills_strike_probability: Out of 255: how likely a guard of skill i is to strike
texts.property.guard_x: Horizontal position in the room, in game units
texts.property.hall_of_fame_entries: How many Hall of Fame entries are filled
texts.property.hall_of_fame_name: The names entered after winning, best time first
texts.property.hall_of_fame_ticks: Ticks that were left in the minute
texts.property.kid_action: What his current sequence is doing
texts.property.kid_alive: Negative while alive; counts up after he dies
texts.property.kid_fall_x: Horizontal speed while falling or jumping
texts.property.kid_fall_y: Falling speed, also how far he has fallen (under 22 is one row, under 33 two)
texts.property.kid_grab_timer: Ticks before he can grab a ledge again
texts.property.kid_have_sword: Nonzero once he has the sword
texts.property.kid_holding_sword: Nonzero while he holds the sword
texts.property.kid_hp_at_level_start: Hit points a restarted level gives back
texts.property.kid_max_hp: Hit points he can have (the bottles on screen)
texts.property.kid_off_guard: Nonzero when he put the sword away in a fight
texts.property.kid_pickup_object_type: What he is picking up (potion type, or the sword)
texts.property.kid_pos_x: Kid.X as a number (JaffarPlus's interpolated position)
texts.property.kid_pos_y: Kid.Y adjusted through climbing, hanging and jump-grab frames (JaffarPlus's interpolated position)
texts.property.kid_repeat: Repeat counter of his current sequence
texts.property.kid_united_with_shadow: Nonzero after he merges with his shadow (level 12)
texts.property.kid_x: Horizontal position in the room, in game units (a tile is 14)
texts.property.kid_y: Vertical position: the floor line he stands on (55, 118 or 181 in the room's three rows)
texts.property.level_checkpoint: Nonzero once level 3's checkpoint is reached
texts.property.level_colours: Level i's colour variation (0: none; 1.3 and 1.4 only)
texts.property.level_current: The level being played (a poke does not load another; see Level.Next)
texts.property.level_demo_index: Position in the demo level's recorded moves
texts.property.level_demo_time: Ticks left of the demo level's current move
texts.property.level_door_open: Nonzero once the exit door is open; 2 when it has been entered
texts.property.level_exit_room_timer: Ticks before a room change can happen again
texts.property.level_jumped_through_mirror: Level 4's mirror: -1 once the prince has jumped through it
texts.property.level_moving_objects: How many Mob[] slots are in use
texts.property.level_next: The level the game goes to when this tick ends; set it to leave the level
texts.property.level_start_direction: The way the prince faces at the start
texts.property.level_start_position: The tile the level starts on (0-29)
texts.property.level_start_room: The room the level starts in
texts.property.level_tile_animations: How many Trob[] slots are in use
texts.property.level_upside_down: Nonzero while the screen is upside down (the level 7 potion)
texts.property.level_used_rooms: How many rooms the level has
texts.property.mobs_x: A falling loose floor's horizontal position (the first Level.Moving Objects are in use)
texts.property.random_seed: The game's random number generator (seed = seed * 214013 + 2531011 at each draw)
texts.property.room_guards_direction: The way room i+1's guard faces
texts.property.room_guards_sequence_high: Room i+1's guard's sequence, high byte
texts.property.room_guards_sequence_low: Room i+1's guard's sequence, low byte (a guard remembered in another room)
texts.property.room_guards_tile: The tile room i+1's guard starts on (30 or more: no guard)
texts.property.room_guards_x: Room i+1's guard's position within his tile
texts.property.room_links_down: The room below room i+1 (0: none)
texts.property.room_links_left: The room beyond the left edge of room i+1 (0: none)
texts.property.room_links_right: The room beyond the right edge of room i+1 (0: none)
texts.property.room_links_up: The room above room i+1 (0: none)
texts.property.room_modifier: The tile's modifier: a gate's openness, a potion's kind, a button's first event, a chomper's phase
texts.property.room_tile: The tile, element i being tile i (0-9 the top row, 10-19, 20-29)
texts.property.room_tile_flag: Bit 5 of the tile byte: on a loose floor, one that does not fall
texts.property.sound_is_screaming: Nonzero while the falling scream plays
texts.property.sound_last_loose_sound: Which of the loose floor sounds played last
texts.property.sound_need_level_1_music: Nonzero until level 1's opening music has played
texts.property.time_core_clock: The core's clock since power-on, 1,764,000 counts a second (what the steps are measured in)
texts.property.time_igt_ms: The in-game time in milliseconds, 12 ticks a second (as quickerSDLPoP shows it: IGT mm:ss.mmm)
texts.property.time_igt_ticks: The in-game time: the ticks the game's clock has counted down since the game started (a minute is 719 of them; the clock stops in cutscenes, on the potions level and after Jaffar)
texts.property.time_minutes_left: Minutes left on the game's clock (negative: no time limit)
texts.property.time_ticks_left: Ticks left in the current minute, 12 a second (719 down to 0)
texts.property.trobs_tile: An animating tile - a gate, a button, a chomper, a potion (the first Level.Tile Animations are in use)
texts.setting.cheats.about: Starts the game with its cheat word, as the DOS game was started from the command line (megahit, or improved for 1.3 and 1.4). The cheat buttons exist only when this is on. It also lets Next Level (Shift+L) skip any level without cutting the time to 15 minutes.
texts.setting.enable_copyprot.about: The original game's copy protection. After level 1 comes the potions level, where the prince must drink the potion whose letter the manual gives. It is on in 1.0. SDLPoP turns it off by default.
texts.setting.enable_crouch_after_climbing.abo: Pressing down and forward together right after climbing up makes the prince crouch. In the original he always climbs back down.
texts.setting.enable_freeze_time_during_end_mu: Freeze time during the end music
The clock stops while a level's ending music plays. In the original it keeps running.
texts.setting.enable_jump_grab.about: The prince can grab the floor above while jumping (Shift and Up without forward).
texts.setting.enable_remember_guard_hp.about: A guard keeps the hit points he had when the prince comes back into his room.
texts.setting.enable_super_high_jump.about: During feather fall (after the green potion) the prince can jump two floors up.
texts.setting.first_level.about: The level a new game starts on. The original game starts on 1.
texts.setting.fix_bigpillar_climb.about: When the prince climbs up to a floor that has a big pillar top behind it, facing right, the floor is no longer drawn see-through.
texts.setting.fix_caped_prince_sliding_through: Crouching with the back to a closed gate at a room's left edge no longer slides through it.
texts.setting.fix_chompers_not_starting.about: Grabbing a ledge a floor or more down starts the chompers on that row.
texts.setting.fix_dead_floating_in_air.about: A body on a loose floor that drops falls with it.
texts.setting.fix_doortop_disabling_guard: Fix: guards on a door top
texts.setting.fix_doortop_disabling_guard.abou: A guard or prince standing on a door top no longer makes guards inactive.
texts.setting.fix_drop_through_tapestry.about: The prince can no longer drop through a closed gate with a tapestry above it.
texts.setting.fix_edge_distance_check_when_cli: Climbing to a higher floor no longer checks the edge below, which could teleport the prince.
texts.setting.fix_exit_door.about: Closed exit doors can no longer be entered after meeting the shadow, after Jaffar dies, or after opening another exit.
texts.setting.fix_falling_through_floor_during: The prince or a guard no longer falls through the floor during a sword strike.
Feather fall affects only the prince, not the guards.
texts.setting.fix_feather_interrupted_by_level: Fix: feather fall and the level door
A level door finishing opening no longer ends feather fall.
texts.setting.fix_gate_drawing_bug.about: The top of a gate under another gate is drawn.
texts.setting.fix_gate_sounds.about: If a room is linked to itself on the left, the closing sounds of its gates can be heard.
texts.setting.fix_glide_through_wall.about: Turning around while running no longer glides through walls.
texts.setting.fix_grab_falling_speed.about: After jumping and bumping into a wall, the prince no longer grabs a ledge two floors down.
texts.setting.fix_guard_following_through_clos: Guards no longer follow the prince to the next room through a closed gate.
texts.setting.fix_hang_on_teleport.about: Grabbing a ledge at a bottom corner of a room no longer teleports the prince to the room above.
texts.setting.fix_hidden_floors_during_flashin: After the prince unites with the shadow on level 12, the hidden floors appear immediately.
texts.setting.fix_infinite_down_bug.about: A room linked to itself at the bottom, with no floor in the prince's column, no longer makes the game stop responding.
texts.setting.fix_jump_distance_at_edge: Fix: jump distance at an edge
texts.setting.fix_jump_distance_at_edge.about: Climbing up two floors, turning and jumping up no longer makes the prince fall (trick 25 is no longer needed).
texts.setting.fix_jump_through_wall_above_gate: Fix: jump through a wall above a gate
A running jump into a wall no longer falls behind a closed gate two floors down (the level 7 skip).
texts.setting.fix_jumping_over_guard.about: A timed running jump no longer jumps over a guard.
texts.setting.fix_land_against_gate_or_tapestr: Landing against a closed gate or a tapestry plays the whole landing animation.
texts.setting.fix_loose_left_of_potion: Fix: loose floor left of a potion
texts.setting.fix_loose_left_of_potion.about: Fixes how a loose floor to the left of a potion or sword is drawn.
texts.setting.fix_move_after_drink.about: The controls are released properly after drinking a potion.
texts.setting.fix_move_after_sheathe.about: Releasing down while putting the sword away no longer makes the prince duck.
texts.setting.fix_offscreen_guards_disappearin: Guards pushed offscreen reappear in the next room.
texts.setting.fix_one_hp_stops_blinking.about: A single hit point keeps blinking after Jaffar is defeated.
texts.setting.fix_painless_fall_on_guard: Fix: painless fall on a guard
texts.setting.fix_painless_fall_on_guard.about: Falling from a great height onto a guard hurts.
texts.setting.fix_press_through_closed_gates.a: Buttons right of a closed gate can no longer be pressed through it (trick 1).
texts.setting.fix_push_guard_into_wall.about: Guards can no longer be pushed into walls.
texts.setting.fix_quicksave_during_feather.abo: Feather fall keeps its length when the game switches between the walking and fighting speeds.
texts.setting.fix_register_quick_input.about: A key pressed and released between two ticks still counts.
texts.setting.fix_retreat_without_leaving_room: Fix: retreat out of a room
Retreating in a sword fight can no longer leave a room without the room changing (trick 35).
texts.setting.fix_running_jump_through_tapestr: Fix: running jump through a tapestry
A running jump to the left no longer goes through a tapestry with a floor above.
texts.setting.fix_safe_landing_on_spikes.about: Landing on the edge of a spikes tile is no longer safe (trick 65).
texts.setting.fix_skeleton_chomper_blood.about: A chomper that chomps a skeleton does not become bloody.
texts.setting.fix_stand_on_thin_air.about: Standing up from a crouch on a falling loose tile no longer stands on thin air.
texts.setting.fix_turn_running_near_wall: Fix: turning to run near a wall
texts.setting.fix_turn_running_near_wall.about: Turning to run right next to a wall, gate or tapestry makes the prince take a careful step, as he would when facing it (tricks 1 and 2).
texts.setting.fix_two_coll_bug.about: An open gate or chomper no longer lets the prince go through walls (tricks 7, 37, 62).
texts.setting.fix_unintended_sword_strike.abou: Drawing the sword no longer sometimes strikes immediately.
texts.setting.fix_wall_bump_triggers_tile_belo: Fix: wall bump drops the tile below
Bumping against a wall no longer drops a loose floor below (tricks 18, 34).
texts.setting.max_hitp_allowed.about: The most hit points the prince can reach with life potions. The original game has 10.
texts.setting.player_name.about: The name that a won game enters in the hall of fame when its time earns a place there. It is entered as the player would have typed it. Only printable characters are used, and only as many as fit in the box (24 at most). The controls have no letter keys, so the game enters the name by itself.
texts.setting.random_seed.about: The starting value (seed) of the game's random number generator. The DOS game took it from the clock. A movie records the number it ran with.
texts.setting.skip_title.about: Starts the first level immediately and does not play the title sequence.
texts.setting.sound.about: 'digital' is the Sound Blaster's digitized sound effects and the AdLib music, as SDLPoP plays them. 'pcSpeaker' is the PC speaker's sounds. The game waits for some sounds to end (the music at the end of a level, the title). So it is part of the machine, and a movie needs the same value. 'digital' needs the DIGISND and MIDISND files.
texts.setting.start_hitp.about: The hit points at the start of the game. The original game has 3.
texts.setting.start_minutes_left.about: The minutes on the clock at the start. The original game has 60. -1 means no time limit.
texts.setting.use_fixes_and_enhancements.about: SDLPoP's fixes for the original game's bugs, and its gameplay enhancements. Off is the original game. On applies those of the settings below that are turned on (all of them are off by default).
texts.setting.version.about: Which release of Prince of Persia is played. The project supplies that release's files. 1.0 (1990) and 1.1 (the IBM PC release) have the same data files. 1.3 (1992) and 1.4 (the Prince of Persia Collection CD) also have the same data files as each other. Those differ from the earlier ones in the level colours (the dungeon of level 3 is green, not blue), two sounds and the music. The guards fight by the tables of 1.0 in 1.0, and by the later tables in 1.1, 1.3 and 1.4. The copy protection asks from each release's own manual (one for 1.0, one for 1.1, and one for 1.3 and 1.4). Each release's PRINCE.EXE is checked too, because it is the file that tells the two releases of a pair apart.
texts.slot.levels.help: A LEVELS.DAT file with a custom level set (from a level editor or a mod). It is played in place of the original levels. The rest of the game still comes from the release's original data. Leave it empty for the original game.
texts.slot.savestate.help: An SDLPoP quicksave (QUICKSAVE.SAV, saved with F6 in SDLPoP 1.16 or later). The run starts from it on the first tick, and not at the title. It holds the whole level as it was, the prince, the guard, the time and the random seed.
